premises.text: People fail at saving because retail environments exploit hunting-gathering impulse instincts
premises.evidence_span: marketers and retailers have figured this out a long time ago

premises.text: Budget-and-spreadsheet personal finance products fail because they try to change people rather than fit saving to people
premises.evidence_span: Instead of changing people or trying to to fit into savings, we've actually changed saving to fit into people

premises.text: Users get an FDIC-insured interest-bearing piggy bank linked to checking plus personal savings goals
premises.evidence_span: they create an online piggy bank, a savings account that's FDIC-insured and interest-bearing

premises.text: At the impulse moment, app or scan transfers the would-be spend into the savings goal with instant gratification feedback
premises.evidence_span: have the amount she was just about to have spent be transferred automatically in that moment into her ImpulseSave savings account

premises.text: Optional social sharing of impulse saves creates bragging and community reinforcement
premises.evidence_span: close to 40% of our users choose to share their impulse saves

premises.text: Multi-channel impulse save (app, Instagram hashtag, SMS, in-site) plus goal marketing notifications drive habit
premises.evidence_span: you can impulse save from wherever you are, and you can impulse save whenever the impulse strikes you

premises.text: Users save thousands per year on average versus relying on budgets
premises.evidence_span: our savers are saving over $3,000 a year right now

value.text: Make saving money as easy and instantly gratifying as spending
value.evidence_span: made it just as easy and as instantly gratifying to save your money as it is to spend it

causal_links.evidence_span: You just saved $25 towards your trip to Paris
actual Americans that are saving instead of buying
we're actually taking your goals, your aspirations, and your priorities in your life
